topics.label: Lecture introduction and objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture on cancer evolution and outlines the session's core learning objectives.

topics.label: Cell-intrinsic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive clonal evolution in pre-malignant tissues.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell hierarchies in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how tissue stem cell hierarchies and the cell of origin influence cancer initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Role of the microenvironment and inflammation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how microenvironmental signals and inflammatory cues promote tumor initiation, progression, and maintenance.

topics.label: Technologies for studying cancer evolution and tissue interactions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental and computational technologies used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of cancer evolutionary dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how genetic, cellular, and environmental factors converge to shape cancer evolutionary trajectories.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing remarks and an outlook on the upcoming lecture.
